name: create-huntable-agent
description: Add a new extraction sub-agent to Huntable CTI Studio as a first-class peer of CmdlineExtract, ProcTreeExtract, HuntQueriesExtract, RegistryExtract, ServicesExtract, and ScheduledTasksExtract. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "add a new agent", "create a sub-agent", "wire up a new extractor", "add a new extraction type", or anything related to adding a new LangGraph extraction sub-agent to the agentic workflow pipeline. This covers the full stack: schema, config pipeline, migration, services, routes, UI templates, config display JS, presets, and tests.
